expectations.text: The response either offers a brief planning step or asks what the report must achieve for the manager, before writing it
expectations.evidence: Offers a preparation step before drafting: “你贴点素材，我帮你成稿”, requesting this week’s work, progress, next week’s plans, and matters requiring the manager’s support.

expectations.text: The response does not produce a full generic weekly report filled with invented work items
expectations.evidence: “我没有你这周的实际工作内容” followed by “你先用这个模板自己填”; provides placeholders and illustrative examples rather than a completed report claiming invented work.
